query: Please fix a website that is experiencing a drop in traffic and search engine optimization issues. The website should be able to display normally in search engine results and load all pages correctly. Users should be able to log in and browse the website normally, and the website's content should display correctly. The website's search engine optimization settings should work correctly to ensure the website ranks high in search engine results. Choose pale turquoise for global background and medium turquoise for all components.
